displayName: Allegro API - Offers, Every Seller's Price, Sellers, Sold Counts
description: Allegro API as structured JSON - search allegro.pl (and allegro.cz, allegro.sk, allegro.hu) by keyword or browse a category, 60 organic offers per page plus sponsored slots, with price, price incl. delivery, condition, auction state, discount and the EU 30-day lowest price, sold count ("x people bought"), Allegro Smart!, seller (super seller, positive feedback percent, business or private) and the placement (regular, promoted, sponsored), sorted by price, price with delivery, popularity, ending soonest or newest and filtered by price, new or used, buy now or auction, Smart! and the deals zone; read one offer in full (parameters, GTIN, delivery methods and prices, stock, returns, warranty, auction bids); read one catalog product with its lowest price, offer count, buy-box offer, star distribution, review aspects and the first 20 reviews; list every seller's offer for one product for price comparison; read a seller's offers and categories and a seller's buyer ratings. 7 endpoints, 2 credits each.

semanticRubric.prompt: Did the agent validate API outcomes instead of assuming success?
Did the agent preserve evidence for request/response behavior and error handling?
